# armilla-astrolabe

> Carry-free residue-number-system engine on ordinary CPUs: exact integer arithmetic on coprime prime rings, with a ternary pull engine, an exact training step and RNS modular exponentiation.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/armilla-astrolabe && cd armilla-astrolabe && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy pytest && PYTHONPATH=engine python3 -m pytest -q engine/tests` (expect: 9 passed).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
